article.headline: San Antonio plays Phoenix, looks for 5th straight road win
article.description: San Antonio Spurs (8-2, second in the Western Conference) vs. Phoenix Suns (3-5, 12th in the Western Conference)
article.title: San Antonio plays Phoenix, looks for 5th straight road win
article.linkText: San Antonio plays Phoenix, looks for 5th straight road win
article.story: San Antonio Spurs (8-2, second in the Western Conference) vs. Phoenix Suns (3-5, 12th in the Western Conference) Phoenix; Monday, 9 p.m. EST BOTTOM LINE: San Antonio visits Phoenix aiming to continue its four-game road winning streak. Phoenix finished 45-37 overall and 29-23 in Western Conference games last season. The Suns averaged 112.6 points per game last season, 43.1 in the paint, 19.9 off of turnovers and 14.1 on fast breaks. San Antonio finished 62-20 overall and 36-16 in Western Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Spurs averaged 119.8 points per game while allowing opponents to score 111.5 last season. INJURIES: Suns: Mark Williams: out (shoulder), Jordan Goodwin: out (calf). Spurs: Jayden Quaintance: out (knee), Tobias Harris: out (calf). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
